name: Shawn Kirkpatrick
headline: VP of Professional Services at C3 Integrated Solutions
about:
Technology leader with broad industry experience, including operations, cloud computing, security solutions, data protection, compliance, collaboration, voice, and system/process automation. Achieved industry leading vendor certifications including Microsoft Certified Solutions Master (MCSM). Directed and managed technical sales, delivery, and support for over 5 Microsoft partner consulting organizations, and have Architected over 200 unique cloud solution deployments.
… more

experiences.description: Focused on helping businesses of all sizes define and achieve goals and objectives through the use of cloud solutions, from envisioning to enablement/operations.

Developing and Leading Operations for Professional Consulting Services, including Project Management Office (PMO), Sales Operations, Service Operations, Human Resources and Marketing departments/services.
•	Standardized company operations for Sales, Service Delivery, Marketing and HR
•	Developed and deployed security & compliance procedures
•	Spearheaded deployment of Dynamics 365 to drive business automation
•	Defined and tracked business metrics across the organization
•	Directed and mentored managers on practice leadership and development
•	Aligned business objectives and internal IT services

Founded and led organization providing Professional and Managed Services focused on cloud and Microsoft Technologies.

•	Built a team providing cloud consulting and managed services for local SMB customers
•	Developed business goals/objectives/roadmap, and delegated execution to team members
•	Provided Practice Management consulting to multiple Microsoft Partners as a business consultant
•	Coordinated with business partners, legal counsel, and accounting services to ensure business compliance and success

•Develop and drive product and marketing strategies built on deep business, ecosystem, product and market understanding.
•Bring together engineering and marketing to establish a compelling value proposition.
•Voice of the consumer, by working with practices to distill customer feedback across multiple sources, drive independent research, dive deep into market research data.
•Intelligently and effectively articulate and demo the value proposition.
•Collaborate with other consumer product and marketing teams so the product strategy and requirements are taken into consideration for their product releases.

Developed, deployed and managed the hosted Exchange 2013 service offering from conceptual design and cost analysis to building the operations team.
Directed the planning and oversight for hosted service offerings built around Lync, System Center and Hyper-V.

Technical lead for the Microsoft Lync and System Center practices responsible for program development and delivery support including:

Developing standard practices for service delivery
Driving standardization for deployments
Providing guidance to architects on complex designs
Ensuring application of technical solutions to meet business objectives
Functioning as the Technical project manager for qualified deployments
Developing field engineer training and mentoring programs
Provide design, deployment, training and escalation services for Microsoft Lync Enterprise Voice/Unified Communications and System Center Private Cloud practices.
